annotations.title: Disconnect an AI app from this account

description: Disconnect one AI app: every token it holds stops working at once, and it has to be authorised again to reconnect. Call once without confirm to get exactly what would be disconnected, show the user, then call again with confirm:true. Read back from the key store. Free.

appId.description: the id from list_connected_apps (or the app name when unique)

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed

name: revoke_connected_app
